title: v1.0 — Salon finances, clients, expenses & invoices
summary: First tagged release. Adds client profiles with comment reminders, business expenses with net profit, invoices with PDF/photo attachments, and browser notifications.
changes: Client profile page with comment timeline and optional reminders
Business expenses with category filters, Excel/PDF export, and net profit in Analytics + Dashboard
Invoices with line items, paid/unpaid status, and PDF/photo attachments stored in IndexedDB
PDF invoices are parsed on upload to pre-fill vendor, date, total, and currency
Optional browser notifications for due client reminders
Device storage diagnostics and versioned backups during schema migrations
CI pipeline with i18n parity check and regression tests
